required_findings.criteria: Identifies that focusProperties { canFocus = false } removes the Smaller and Larger buttons from keyboard, D-pad, and other focus-based navigation, so hardware keyboard and switch users relying on focus cannot reach them, and recommends removing the focusProperties override.

Identifies that converting 12.dp with toSp() divides by the font scale, so the caption stays the same physical size when the user increases font size, and recommends a plain sp size or a typography style.

Identifies that the tips dialog disables back and outside-tap dismissal (dismissOnBackPress = false, dismissOnClickOutside = false) and can be closed only by a vertical drag, so TalkBack, Switch Access, keyboard, and many motor-impaired users cannot close it, and recommends a visible Close button and allowing back dismissal.
Requires device verification of keyboard or D-pad reachability of both buttons, the caption at the largest font scale, and closing the tips dialog with TalkBack and with back navigation.

forbidden_claims: Claims automated tests can prove exact TalkBack speech
Claims the Reading settings title is not exposed as a heading
Claims the Smaller or Larger buttons have no accessible name
